description: Filtered main value multiplied by 1000, truncated to an integer. Kept for legacy masters that can only read one register. Prefer register 1026, which is a float and does not clip.

Device identity, self-reported. 0x50 = density / concentration meter, 0x51 = spectral concentration meter. Firmware older than this feature answers exception 02; treat that as 'type unknown' rather than as an error.
Module status bit flags, see docs/error-codes.md
Hardware wire count. Not used, ignore.
Measurement error bits, 0 = OK. See docs/error-codes.md. THIS is the field that tells you whether the reading is fresh.
Energy change against the reference baseline
Intermediate result from the calibration table
Unit code for the intermediate value, see unit table
Main process value, filtered. THIS IS THE ONE YOU WANT for control and trending.
Unit code for the main value, see unit table
Sampling quality for this cycle, 1 = good. NOT a freshness flag - see the warning in docs/error-codes.md before using it.
Averaging count actually achieved this cycle
Standard deviation of energy across frames
Standard deviation of the DC offset
0 = normal output, non-zero = current-loop calibration mode. When non-zero the 4-20 mA output is held at a fixed test value and does NOT follow the process.
What loop 1 carries: 0 = main value, 1 = temperature, 2 = energy
What loop 2 carries, same codes as output1Type
1 = the probe temperature below is valid. Check this before trusting register 1068.
Seconds since power-on. Useful for detecting an unexpected restart.
Duration of one measurement cycle. Poll no faster than this.

Entrained-gas index, 0-100. 0 = no gas detected. Instantaneous value - a single bubble crossing the beam can spike it. Derived from frame-to-frame variance, not from absolute echo amplitude, which is what lets it separate 'more bubbles' from 'more solids'.

Time-smoothed entrained-gas index. This is the one to alarm on: it ignores isolated bubbles and responds to sustained gas. The instrument's own bubble flag is driven by this value exceeding its threshold for consecutive cycles.
Number of history records the instrument can hold. Self-describing: read this before walking the history area. Firmware without this register answers exception 02.
